summary: Muncy Columbia Financial Corporation filed an 8-K announcing a three-for-one stock split in the form of a 200% stock dividend. The Board declared the split on April 23, 2026. Shareholders of record on May 7, 2026 will receive two additional shares per share held, distributed after May 14, 2026. Post-split shares outstanding will be ~10.6 million. The split is intended to increase liquidity and trading volume. No deal terms apply. This is a routine capital-actions filing, not a special situation.
